dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.closedWinRate: {count, plural, one {# closed trade · {percent} trade win rate} other {# closed trades · {percent} trade win rate}}
dashboard.noFilterMatches: No trades match these filters. Clear or adjust Filters to see more results.
dashboard.closedFees: {count, plural, one {# closed trade · <fees>{feesText}</fees> fees} other {# closed trades · <fees>{feesText}</fees> fees}}

netPnl.label: Net P&L
netPnl.hint: Realized profit and loss net of fees, over the selected range.

tradeWin.label: Trade win %
tradeWin.hint: Winning trades divided by all closed trades, including breakevens.

profitFactor.label: Profit factor
profitFactor.hint: Gross profit ÷ gross loss. Above 1 means the wins outweigh the losses.

dayWin.label: Day win %
dayWin.hint: Green trading days ÷ all trading days in the selected range.

avgWinLoss.label: Avg win / loss
avgWinLoss.hint: Average winning trade ÷ average losing trade. The bar shows the two to scale.
avgWinLoss.barLabel: Average win vs average loss, to scale

edgeScore.label: Edge Score
edgeScore.help: A 0–100 score combining win rate, profit factor, average win/loss, drawdown, recovery, and consistency. Requires at least five closed trades.
edgeScore.empty: Needs 5+ closed trades. The formula is open — read it.

cumulative.label: Cumulative P&L
cumulative.title: Daily net cumulative P&L
cumulative.help: Running total of net profit and loss over the selected period. The drawdown bars below show declines from the running equity peak.

dailyPnl.label: Daily P&L
dailyPnl.title: Net daily P&L
dailyPnl.help: Net profit or loss for each trading day. Bars above zero are profitable; bars below zero are losses.

maxDrawdown.label: Max drawdown
maxDrawdown.hint: Largest peak-to-trough drop of the cumulative P&L curve.

streaks.label: Streaks
streaks.hint: Current run of consecutive wins (W) or losses (L), with the best and worst runs.

expectancy.label: Expectancy / trade
expectancy.hint: Average net P&L per closed trade: what one more trade is worth on your numbers.
expectancy.needsRisk: tag stop-losses to unlock R multiples

avgDuration.label: Avg duration
avgDuration.hint: Average time from first entry fill to final exit.

bestWorstDay.label: Best / worst day
bestWorstDay.hint: Highest and lowest single-day net P&L in the selected range.

timePerformance.label: Trade time performance
timePerformance.help: Trades grouped by their opening hour. The upper chart shows net P&L; the lower chart shows trade count.

empty.title: Your journal is empty
empty.body: Connect a broker for automatic sync, upload a statement from 10+ platforms (including your TradeZella export), or add trades manually.
empty.demoNote: Demo data lands in its own account; delete it anytime under Accounts.

customizer.title: Dashboard cards
customizer.srStatus: {count, plural, one {# card found.} other {# cards found.}} {visible} of {total} visible.

savedLayouts.title: Dashboard layouts
savedLayouts.presetsHint: Choose a focus, then make it yours with Customize.
savedLayouts.cardsCountCurrent: {count, plural, one {# card · Current layout} other {# cards · Current layout}}

presetDescriptions.overview: All cards in the original order.
presetDescriptions.tradingDay: Calendar and recent trades first, then daily results.
presetDescriptions.performance: Returns, win rate, equity, and your trading edge.
presetDescriptions.riskReview: Drawdown, streaks, expectancy, and daily swings.

layout.allShownSaved: All cards are shown. Layout saved.
layout.restoredSaved: Original card order restored. All cards are shown.
layout.saveFailed: Your layout changed, but could not be saved in this browser.
layout.readFailed: Saved dashboard preferences could not be read. All cards are shown.
layout.hiddenBanner: {count, plural, one {# card is hidden in this layout.} other {# cards are hidden in this layout.}}
layout.allHidden: All cards are hidden. Choose Show all cards to restore them.
layout.dragInstructions: Press Space or Enter to pick up a card. Use the arrow keys to move, then Space or Enter to drop. Press Escape to cancel.
layout.outsideCards: Outside the cards. Drop here to cancel.
